claims: The "Inside Out Classic" is a live, real-time animated NHL game.
The "Inside Out Classic" takes place on April 5, 2026, at 7 p.m. ET.
The "Inside Out Classic" features the Washington Capitals vs. New York Rangers.
The "Inside Out Classic" is set in Riley's "Hockey Island" mind world.
The "Inside Out Classic" airs on Disney+, ESPN+, Disney Channel, and Disney XD.
The "Inside Out Classic" features Pixar’s Inside Out characters skating alongside animated NHL players.
The "Inside Out Classic" features Joy, Sadness, Anger, Fear, and Anxiety.
The "Inside Out Classic" uses NHL EDGE positional data.
The "Inside Out Classic" uses Sony's Hawk-Eye Innovations to track player movement.
The "Inside Out Classic" creates an animated version of the live game.
Commentators for the "Inside Out Classic" use virtual reality headsets.
The "Inside Out Classic" takes place on "Hockey Island" within the mind of Riley.
Riley is the protagonist of the Inside Out films.
The "Inside Out Classic" is a child-friendly alternative to the traditional, live-action matchup.
